candidate.answerReason: Applying the annual growth factor 1+x twice gives 5(1+x)²=7.2, which is option A.

methods.label: Apply the annual growth factor twice
methods.explanation: With the same growth rate each year, the collection after two years is \(5(1+x)^2\), so the equation is \(5(1+x)^2=7.2\). B treats compound growth as simple growth.
methods.levelReason: Forms the Grade 9 two-period growth equation without requiring equation solving.
